text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past purchases and listening or viewing activity as broad, continuing interest in related products and content.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations connect when they support a demonstrated task or add a useful function to equipment already owned.",
    "Direct artist connections and specific matches in mood, sound, or story appeal give users recognizable reasons to choose."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items occupy recommendation slots despite lacking the specific task, compatibility, or content connection users require.",
    "Similar devices and older versions are treated as plausible next purchases even when recent ownership already covers their function.",
    "Older or isolated interactions appear to outweigh recent, repeated evidence of current needs and preferences."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad category, brand, product-family, and popularity associations substitute for evidence of a useful next choice.",
    "Shared words, materials, collection formats, or general styles are treated as stronger connections than their actual purpose or experiential appeal supports."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent and repeated activity helps distinguish an active task or current listening and viewing preference from a user's broader history.",
    "Compatibility, dimensions, quantity, and added functionality determine whether a related product is useful now.",
    "Specific artist, mood, and functional connections matter more than broad resemblance; unidentified or ambiguous items provide insufficient evidence of fit rather than evidence of dislike."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "The leading recommendations too often offer broad relevance without a concrete current reason to choose, leaving useful complements and precise content matches mixed with speculative or redundant suggestions.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "Rank-weighted frequency of recommendations users would choose now, distinguished from items they merely consider related or potentially useful.",
    "Frequency of leading recommendations rejected for redundant function, incompatible specifications, unsupported project assumptions, or mismatched mood and style.",
    "Relative ranking of recommendations supported by recent repeated behavior versus those supported only by older isolated interactions or broad associations.",
    "Frequency of uncertain judgments caused by insufficient item identification, tracked separately from explicit preference mismatches."
  ]
}
